executive_summary: Rebuild only the native extension on the common pinned baseline; keep the runtime and dependency versions.
phase2_instruction: Use the coordinator-dispatched baseline identity as --build-arg BASE_IMAGE. Every Docker action, including build and probes, must go through the shared serial docker_slot.py. Phase2 dispatch is required before running this recipe.
phase2_overlay_extensions: Embed native-source-manifest.json and implementation commit label for installed provenance audit
Compile/run the independently extracted queue differential tests with Linux g++ and frozen numeric flags; install separate correctness-only test binary
buildkit_local_image_id_handling: Use the baseline tag only after inspecting it under the lock and asserting it resolves to the dispatched immutable image ID; BuildKit FROM treats bare sha256 image IDs as registry names. All runtime checks still use immutable IDs. Candidate RootFS must retain every baseline layer as its prefix.
